1  HON'BLE VIKRAM D. CHAUHAN, J. 
1.
Heard learned Counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A for the State.

2. This application has been filed by the applicants for quashing of the order dated 15.7.2025 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.3, Kanpur Dehat in Complaint Case No.49976 of 2021, Nansi Gupta Vs. Vineet Gupta and others, under Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 4 D.P.
Act, Police Station Akbarpur, District Kanpur Dehat.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submit that the applicants are husband and family members of the opposite party no.2.
The applicants were earlier enlarged on bail.

However, could not participate in the trial court proceedings, as a result of the same, NBW and process under Section 82 Cr.P.C.
has been issued against the applicants.
The applicants are ready to appear before the court concerned within 10 days from today.

4. In view of the statement made by learned counsel for the applicants, the applicants are directed to appear before the court concerned within 10 days from today and participate in the trial proceedings without seeking unnecessary adjournment.
In the event, the applicants appear before the court concerned in pursuance to this order, the NBW and process under Section 82 Cr.P.C. shall be kept in abeyance.

5. In the event, the applicants fail to participate in the trial proceedings or appear before the court concerned, the interim protection shall automatically stands vacated and the court concerned is at liberty to proceed with the case in accordance with law.
6. Subject to the aforesaid directions, the application stands disposed of.

(Vikram D. Chauhan,J.) October 7, 2025 Bhaskar  Vineet Gupta And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2384287/
